summary: A provider is selected through versioned descriptors; generic scaffold plans dotnet new install/update/create at the RunProcess edge, rather than embedding a producer package or application layout. Provider capability/minimum, reserved parameters and SDD-owned tree collisions are checked before or around provider effects. SDD seeds its process skills and is sole mirror authority: provider skills originate in neutral .agents, the reserved fs-gg-sdd namespace is SDD-owned, and the byte-identical union reaches Claude/Codex/neutral roots with mirrored provenance. The tracked producer manifest is .claude/skills/skill-manifest.json, while neutral-root paths are delivered-view references. Source-side provider/skill contracts and tests do not establish current public scaffold/provider acceptance.
title: SDD owns scaffold effects and skill mirroring
